Vodka (song).h: the song "Vodka" will represent Malta at Eurovision Song Contest 2008

Volví a Nacer.h: the song "Volví a Nacer" by Carlos Vives reached number one in Colombia, Mexico, Venezuela, and the Hot Latin Songs chart in the United States

Vom Himmel hoch, o Engel, kommt.h: in the carol "Vom Himmel hoch, o Engel, kommt", printed in 1622, the angels are requested to come from Heaven with musical instruments, to sing of Jesus and Mary, and for peace

WAP (song).h: a U.S. Republican candidate criticized rappers Cardi B and Megan Thee Stallion's song "WAP", stating that it made him want to "pour holy water" in his ears

Wachet auf, ruft uns die Stimme.a: Wachet auf, ruft uns die Stimme

Wadde hadde dudde da?.h: the song "Wadde Hadde Dudde Da?" consists of tongue twisters in an artificial German dialect and never answers the question in its title

Wah-Wah (song).h: George Harrison wrote the song "Wah-Wah" in response to his frustration with Beatles bandmates John Lennon and Paul McCartney

Wait in the Truck.h: Lainey Wilson said she hoped her duet with Hardy, "Wait in the Truck", haunted domestic abusers

Waitin' on a Sunny Day.h: Bruce Springsteen has described his hit song "Waitin' on a Sunny Day" as the type of song he tends to want to throw out

Waiting Game (Banks song).h: Banks expressed displeasure over Neon Jungle's decision to cover her then-new song "Waiting Game" for their album Welcome to the Jungle

Waiting for a Train (Jimmie Rodgers song.a: Waiting for a Train (Jimmie Rodgers song)

Waking Up.h: Elastica's 1995 song "Waking Up" resulted in the band being sued for plagiarism

Walk on Water (Thirty Seconds to Mars so.a: Walk on Water (Thirty Seconds to Mars song)

Walking Down Madison.h: "Walking Down Madison" is the first song Johnny Marr wrote after the dissolution of The Smiths

Walking on a Thin Line (song).h: the Huey Lewis and the News song "Walking on a Thin Line" is about Vietnam War soldiers and veterans

Wang Dang Sweet Poontang.h: music critic Greg Kot described "Wang Dang Sweet Poontang" as "despicable misogyny", but listed it among his guilty pleasures because the "rawwwk doesn't get much rawer"

War Paint (Fletcher song).h: the song "War Paint" performed by American singer Fletcher was the most shared song on Spotify in the United States for the week commencing June 29, 2015

Was Gott tut, das ist wohlgetan.a: Was Gott tut, das ist wohlgetan

Was Gott tut, das ist wohlgetan, BWV 100.a: Was Gott tut, das ist wohlgetan, BWV 100
Was Gott tut, das ist wohlgetan, BWV 100.h: the Bach cantata Was Gott tut, das ist wohlgetan, BWV 100, includes up to 24 demisemiquavers per bar

Was mein Gott will, das g'scheh allzeit.a: Was mein Gott will, das g'scheh allzeit

Watch Me Do.h: Meghan Trainor's "Watch Me Do" references a number of rap songs

Watch n' Learn.h: according to one reviewer, the reggae drum fill in "Watch n' Learn" originates from Bob Marley's 1983 single "Buffalo Soldier"

Water of Love.h: Mark Knopfler's publisher made a country-style tape of Knopfler's song "Water of Love" without his knowledge, which led to a cover of the song by The Judds

Waymon Alridge.h: The Globe and Mail called Canadian football player Waymon Alridge "the newest Rider star" after he caught passes for 75 and 90 yards in a single game

We Are One (global collaboration song).h: 40 musicians from seven countries collaborated on the song "We Are One", which extends a message of hope and unity to the global population affected by COVID-19

We Didn't Start the Fire (Fall Out Boy s.a: We Didn't Start the Fire (Fall Out Boy song)
We Didn't Start the Fire (Fall Out Boy s.h: Fall Out Boy's updated "We Didn't Start the Fire" mentions Myspace, but not the COVID-19 pandemic

We Don't Have to Dance.h: "We Don't Have To Dance" by Andy Black was written with Fall Out Boy singer Patrick Stump

We Plough the Fields and Scatter.a: We Plough the Fields and Scatter

We Remain.h: according to Sam Lansky from the website Idolator, Christina Aguilera's 2013 song "We Remain" is similar to works of Ryan Tedder

We'll Never Have to Say Goodbye Again.a: We'll Never Have to Say Goodbye Again
We'll Never Have to Say Goodbye Again.h: three artists covered "We'll Never Have to Say Goodbye Again" within two years of its original release

We're the Superhumans.h: Channel 4's 2016 Paralympics trailer "We're the Superhumans" featured a big band comprised of musicians with disabilities

Welcome to the Jungle (Neon Jungle album.h: Welcome to the Jungle contains a cover of a Banks song not officially sanctioned by her

Well Well Well (John Lennon song).h: a line from John Lennon's "Well Well Well" has been interpreted as both a reference to cannibalism and a sexual metaphor

Wenn das Brot, das wir teilen.a: Wenn das Brot, das wir teilen
Wenn das Brot, das wir teilen.h: "Wenn das Brot, das wir teilen" (When the bread that we share), a hymn written in 1981, begins with a reference to the Miracle of the Roses

Wer da gläubet und getauft wird, BWV 37.a: Wer da gläubet und getauft wird, BWV 37
Wer da gläubet und getauft wird, BWV 37.h: Bach's first cantata for the feast of the Ascension, Wer da gläubet und getauft wird, BWV 37, omits the topic of the Ascension and derives from the quoted Gospel (Mark 16:16) Lutheran thoughts

Wer mich liebet, der wird mein Wort halt.a: Wer mich liebet, der wird mein Wort halten, BWV 74
Wer mich liebet, der wird mein Wort halt.h: the Bach cantata Wer mich liebet, der wird mein Wort halten, BWV 74, includes both "childlike openness" and "manic chortling"

Wer unterm Schutz des Höchsten steht.a: Wer unterm Schutz des Höchsten steht
Wer unterm Schutz des Höchsten steht.h: "Wer unterm Schutz des Höchsten steht", a hymn paraphrasing Psalm 91, has been recommended instead of the psalm in the Liturgy of the Hours, and for memorial services after disasters

Wer weiß, wie nahe mir mein Ende.a: Wer weiß, wie nahe mir mein Ende
Wer weiß, wie nahe mir mein Ende.h: Countess Ämilie Juliane von Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt wrote 587 songs and hymns, including "Wer weiß, wie nahe mir mein Ende", used in her regular meditations towards a good death

What Child Is This?.h: the story behind the carol "What Child Is This?" centres around the Adoration of the Shepherds

What Do You Want.h: Terry Bradshaw's daughter Rachel co-wrote Jerrod Niemann's "What Do You Want" and appeared in the song's music video

What I've Been Looking For.h: Ashley Tisdale became the first female artist to have two songs debut at the same time on the US Billboard Hot 100, with "What I've Been Looking For" and "Bop to the Top"

What Now (song).h: the chorus of Rihanna's song "What Now" contains background sounds that resemble "sonic bombs"

What U Workin' With?.h: Gwen Stefani and Justin Timberlake's song "What U Workin' With?" was first revealed through a surprise post on Timberlake's Instagram account

What's Your Country Song.h: Thomas Rhett's "What's Your Country Song" contains lyrical references to 16 other country songs

Whatever It Takes (Leona Lewis song).h: "Whatever It Takes" was the first song to be written for Leona Lewis' debut studio album, Spirit

Wheelie (disambiguation).h: in the music video for her song "Wheelie", Latto shows off a diamond cryptocurrency wallet made by celebrity jeweler Greg Yuna

When This Cruel War Is Over.a: When This Cruel War Is Over
When This Cruel War Is Over.h: "When This Cruel War Is Over" was one of the most popular sentimental ballads of the American Civil War, sung by both Union and Confederate troops

When We Die As Martyrs.h: the song "When We Die As Martyrs" is performed by the Arab children's choir Birds of Paradise

When We Were Young (Adele song).h: Adele's artwork for "When We Were Young" features a picture of her as a child

When the World Is Running Down, You Make.a: When the World Is Running Down, You Make the Best of What's Still Around
When the World Is Running Down, You Make.h: a remix version of The Police song "When the World Is Running Down, You Make the Best of What's Still Around" reached the UK Top 40 two decades after the song's initial release

Where Are You, Dear General?.h: the North Korean song "Where Are You, Dear General?" plays every morning at 6 a.m. through Pyongyang's loudspeakers

Where Have You Been.h: the Rihanna song "Where Have You Been" contains compositional elements of Geoff Mack's "I've Been Everywhere"

Where's Captain Kirk?.h: "Where's Captain Kirk?" by punk/new wave band Spizzenergi was the first number one single on the UK Indie Chart

While shepherds watched their flocks.h: the original title of the Christmas carol "While Shepherds Watched Their Flocks" is "Song of the Angels at the Nativity of our Blessed Saviour"

White Foxes.h: "White Foxes", a 2012 single by singer-songwriter Susanne Sundfør, quickly grew to be the most downloaded song on iTunes in Norway

White Houses.h: the Vanessa Carlton song "White Houses" (2004) provided the inspiration for a charity which aimed to raise money for Habitat for Humanity International

White Knuckles.h: the band OK Go's music video for "White Knuckles" is a one-shot take of the band interacting with twelve trained dogs and a goat

White Shadows.h: Brian Eno, one of the principal innovators of ambient music, played synthesisers on Coldplay's 2007 single "White Shadows"

White as Snow (song).h: the U2 song "White as Snow" was written from the perspective of a dying soldier in Afghanistan

Who Am I (Casting Crowns song).h: Christian rock band Casting Crowns have performed their song "Who Am I" at a Bush-Cheney '04 campaign rally and the 2009 Spring Friendship Art Festival in North Korea

Who Cares? (ballet).h: George Balanchine's ballet Who Cares?, to songs written by George Gershwin, is likened to "a tap dance on pointe"

Who Do You Think You Are Kidding Jurgen.a: Who Do You Think You Are Kidding Jurgen Klinsmann?
Who Do You Think You Are Kidding Jurgen.h: Jürgen Klinsmann disliked the parody song "Who Do You Think You Are Kidding Jurgen Klinsmann?" because he felt it compared him to Hitler

Who Has Seen the Wind? (song).h: Yoko Ono took the first verse of her 1970 song "Who Has Seen the Wind?" from a 19th century poem written by Christina Rossetti

Who Says (Selena Gomez & the Scene song).a: Who Says (Selena Gomez & the Scene song)
Who Says (Selena Gomez & the Scene song).h: "Who Says" is said to be inspired by the hate Selena Gomez received online due to her relationship with Justin Bieber

Who shall separate us?.h: in "Who shall separate us?", composed by James MacMillan for the state funeral of Elizabeth II, verses from Romans 8 are followed by Alleluias described as "burning bright sonic trails"

Who's That Chick?.h: when "Who's That Chick?" debuted at number nine on the UK Singles Chart, Rihanna became only the fourth act in UK chart history to have at least three songs in the top ten of the UK Singles Chart

Why Baby Why.h: the chart run for George Jones' first chart single "Why Baby Why" was interrupted when Red Sovine and Webb Pierce released a duet cover of the same song

Why Can't I Be You?.h: the video for The Cure's 1987 single "Why Can't I Be You?" featured Robert Smith dancing in a bear suit

Why Don't You Love Me (Beyoncé song).a: Why Don't You Love Me (Beyoncé Knowles song)
Why Don't You Love Me (Beyoncé song).h: the song "Why Don't You Love Me", performed by Beyoncé, peaked at number one in the Billboard Hot Dance Club Songs chart, though it was never released as single

Why So Lonely.h: "Why So Lonely" is the first Wonder Girls single written by the members of the band

Wide Awake (Katy Perry song).h: the 3D music video for "Wide Awake" will be used as a tie-in promotion for the 2012 documentary-concert film, Katy Perry: Part of Me as part of her deal with Pepsi

Wie als een God wil leven.a: Wie als een God wil leven
Wie als een God wil leven.h: the 1965 song "Wie als een God wil leven", written by Huub Oosterhuis, was listed in 2013 as a hymn in German successful with young people

Wie schön leuchtet der Morgenstern, BWV.a: Wie schön leuchtet der Morgenstern, BWV 1

Wild Roses (song).h: Of Monsters and Men filmed the music video for their song "Wild Roses" in 12 hours, just before beginning a tour

Willow (song).h: the music video for Taylor Swift's single "Willow" avoids showing some dancers' faces because they were wearing masks as a COVID-19 precaution

Wish You Were Gay.h: after Billie Eilish wrote the song "Wish You Were Gay", its subject came out to her as gay

Witch Hunt (song).h: the differences between live versions of Rush's "Witch Hunt" were seen as an instance of "translation" à la Walter Benjamin

Witness (Katy Perry album).h: ticket purchases for Witness: The Tour will include copies of Katy Perry's album Witness

Wo Gott der Herr nicht bei uns hält, BWV.a: Wo Gott der Herr nicht bei uns hält, BWV 178

Wo Menschen sich vergessen.h: "Wo Menschen sich vergessen" was the first song in the opening service of the 2021 Ecumenical Church Assembly in Frankfurt, held as an open-air livestream

Wohl dem, der sich auf seinen Gott, BWV.a: Wohl dem, der sich auf seinen Gott, BWV 139

Won't Get Fooled Again.h: "Won't Get Fooled Again" was the last song Keith Moon ever played live with The Who

Wonderous Stories.h: "Wonderous Stories" by the progressive rock band Yes remains their highest charting UK single with a peak at number 7 in 1977

Word Crimes.h: "Word Crimes", "Weird Al" Yankovic's grammar-based song parody of Robin Thicke's "Blurred Lines", has been likened to a modern-day Schoolhouse Rock!

Word of God Speak.h: Bart Millard intended the music to the song "Word of God Speak" to mirror its overall lyrical theme

Work (Iggy Azalea song).h: the music video of "Work" featured Iggy Azalea engaging in twerking and lap dancing sequences

World Quest/Pokopon Pekōrya.h: Japanese idol group NEWS became the third group in history to earn their fifteenth consecutive number-one single on the weekly Oricon singles chart with "World Quest/Pokopon Pekōrya"

World's Fair (album).h: Julian Lage's album World's Fair was inspired by Andrés Segovia

Wrap Me Up (Jimmy Fallon and Meghan Trai.a: Wrap Me Up (Jimmy Fallon and Meghan Trainor song)

Wär Gott nicht mit uns diese Zeit.a: Wär Gott nicht mit uns diese Zeit

Xander Rawlins.h: "1000 Miles Apart" was written by a British army captain serving in Afghanistan and is a contender for the 2010 UK Christmas number-one single

Y Ahora Te Vas.h: Mexican group Los Bukis won the Lo Nuestro Award for Best Regional Mexican Song in 1989 with their number-one single "Y Ahora Te Vas"

Yahweh (song).h: critic Christopher Gray said the U2 song "Yahweh" could be about Jesus or lead singer Bono's two children

Yasss Bish.h: "Yasss Bish" is a bounce and drill song with a trap beat

Ye Choirs of New Jerusalem.h: "Ye Choirs of New Jerusalem" has been described as the "only medieval resurrection hymn still widely sung"

Year of the Rabbit (ballet).h: musician Sufjan Stevens, who initially disliked ballet, allowed his music to be used in Year of the Rabbit after choreographer Justin Peck invited him to various performances

You Are the Girl.h: "You Are the Girl" was The Cars' only Top 40 hit after they regrouped from a three-year hiatus in 1987

You Can't Stop Me.h: plans for an elephant to appear in the Guano Apes' circus-themed music video "You Can't Stop Me" were cancelled after the elephant's owner threatened a rival circus family

You Don't Know What to Do.a: You Don't Know What to Do
You Don't Know What to Do.h: Mariah Carey is said to "channel" Jocelyn Brown in her song "You Don't Know What to Do"

You Love Me?.h: "You Love Me?" by Melissa Steel features production by Darkchild, whose previous hits were the reason Steel became a singer

You Make Me Wanna....h: Usher's 1997 song "You Make Me Wanna" is an acoustic guitar-based R&B, soul and pop ballad about "juggling three women"

You're Breakin' My Heart.h: George Harrison played on Harry Nilsson's infamously profanity-laden song "You're Breakin' My Heart"

You're No Good (Jesse Fuller song).h: Jesse Fuller's first release of his song "You're No Good" was more than a year after Bob Dylan had included it on his debut album

You're on Fire.h: the music video for the They Might Be Giants song "You're on Fire" stars Lauren Lapkus of Orange is the New Black and a singing silicone meat puppet

Young Americans (song).h: David Bowie frequently updated the lyrics for his song "Young Americans" to keep them contemporary

Yours (Steven Curtis Chapman song).h: Steven Curtis Chapman's song "Yours" was the 45th number-one single of his career

Zeit (Rammstein album).h: a song from Rammstein's eighth album Zeit premiered on the International Space Station

Zenga Zenga.h: the Libyan opposition has embraced "Zenga Zenga", an Israeli-created auto-tuned song and viral YouTube video that parodies Libyan ruler Muammar Gaddafi

Zoom (The Knack album).h: The Knack's second comeback attempt, the 1998 album Zoom, was described as their best since their debut album Get The Knack
